verdict: NO-GO as it stands. The shape is right (one file per task, owns/needs/after, M0..M6 with one sitting each, a tool-checked trace) and tools/ci all is green, so the plan is close. Three things keep it from the stage-B bar: (1) the requirement trace is formally complete (reqs: ok) but materially false, because 29 ids are cited by ten or more tasks (the 23 unit-level rows of 10 10.1 by 18 to 19 tasks each, the ten error-id rows 0437 to 0446 by 9 to 11), so grep -l REQ-0765 answers 18 tasks of which one builds the recorder; (2) five pairs of open tasks that no edge orders own the same path (the plan's own rule 3 fails them once tools/ci plan lands); (3) the critical path contradicts the narrative: every M1 chain starts at T121 -> T105 -> T106 -> T009 -> T013 -> T051 (sitting M1 at depth 9, T074 at depth 20, unit weight), while the narrative says the four foundation packages need nothing of M0, and T105, the head, waits for an answer at 'the sitting that opens M0' when the plan defines sitting M0 as the one that merges M0. Retire-early and 80/20 are honoured by the milestone content (M1 julieta daily, M2 product kits, M3 sync, M4 nothing lost); the one exception is item 19, which parks the open-items cut-over in M5.
